scenes.tts: How can losing nearly half your enzyme make purification better? Follow the gold target through one sample, and the answer becomes visible. Gold tokens mark active target. The whole gold-and-grey pile represents total protein.
scenes.visual: THE WORLD, carried through the whole film: a large transparent sample vessel fills 65% of frame height, with a wide outlet gate at its base and a discard tray beside it. Inside, four GOLD target tokens and thirty-six GREY contaminant tokens drift continuously in slow convection; token counts are illustrative, so a full-opacity label 'schematic sample' (TEXT 28+) stays at lower right. COLOR MAP: GOLD active target, GREY other protein, TEAL retained sample and formulas, RED discarded material, BLUE separation-property controls. No molecular structures: only labelled disks, vessels, gates, bars and counters. On the opening question, the outlet opens and two of the four GOLD tokens (nearly half, as at the later affinity step) plus almost all GREY tokens pour toward the RED discard tray; the GOLD loss flashes a question mark. On 'answer becomes visible', the remaining sample vessel expands and the discard stream freezes into two animated percentage gauges. On 'Gold tokens', one GOLD token pulses. On 'whole gold-and-grey pile', a TEAL bracket sweeps around every token while all tokens continue drifting.
scenes.narration: How can losing nearly half your enzyme make purification better? Follow the gold target through one sample, and the answer becomes visible. Gold tokens mark active target. The whole gold-and-grey pile represents total protein.

scenes.visual: Do not cut away. The vessel remains at 25% opacity and its tokens keep drifting. The title 'Purity Through Selective Loss' (TITLE_FONT 54) grows from the outlet gate, with BIOCHEMISTRYPEDIA above in TEAL. The title retracts into the gate during the last 0.4 seconds; the sample returns to full opacity.

scenes.tts: Before any separation, you need an assay that finds the target. For an enzyme, its reaction reports activity in units. Total protein measures every protein in the same tube.
scenes.visual: Carry the full vessel and drifting tokens. Before 'assay', a small scanner bar sweeps from bottom to top through the vessel; GOLD tokens glow only as the bar crosses them, then feed a live counter labelled 'target activity' (GOLD, 32). On 'reaction reports', the counter clicks upward in units while GOLD tokens gently pulse. On 'Total protein', the scanner widens across both GOLD and GREY tokens and feeds a second counter labelled 'total protein, mg' (TEAL, 32). Both counters remain anchored to the vessel's right side and update by one small tick as tokens drift past.
scenes.narration: Before any separation, you need an assay that finds the target. For an enzyme, its reaction reports activity in units. Total protein measures every protein in the same tube.

scenes.tts: Our crude homogenate has one hundred thousand activity units and ten thousand milligrams of protein. Divide activity by total protein. Specific activity is ten units per milligram.
scenes.caption: Our crude homogenate has 100,000 activity units and 10,000 milligrams of protein. Divide activity by total protein. Specific activity is 10 units per milligram.
scenes.visual: The vessel stays large at left; tokens keep circulating. On 'one hundred thousand', the GOLD counter rolls to '100,000 activity units'. On 'ten thousand', the TEAL counter rolls to '10,000 mg total protein'. On 'Divide', the two counters slide into a stacked TEXT fraction bar in the centre, activity above protein, while the vessel narrows but remains visible. A TEAL result counter computes digit by digit and settles on 'specific activity = 10 units/mg'. A small GOLD fraction of the pile glows brighter as the result lands.
scenes.narration: Our crude homogenate has 100,000 activity units and 10,000 milligrams of protein. Divide activity by total protein. Specific activity is 10 units per milligram.

scenes.tts: The salt cut keeps ninety percent of target activity but only thirty percent of total protein. Specific activity triples, from ten to thirty. Purity rose although some target was lost.
scenes.caption: The salt cut keeps 90% of target activity but only 30% of total protein. Specific activity triples, from 10 to 30. Purity rose although some target was lost.
scenes.visual: Rebuild the vessel full at left with the two counters from s03. On 'keeps ninety percent', the base gate opens: one of ten small GOLD activity markers moves to the RED discard tray while nine arc into a smaller retained vessel. On 'only thirty percent', seven of ten equal TEAL total-protein bars slide to discard and three remain under the retained vessel; both proportions are computed from the stated percentages. The token cloud follows continuously, with mostly GREY tokens leaving and a few GOLD targets retained. On 'triples', the specific-activity counter rolls from 10 to 30 and grows threefold in width. On 'some target was lost', the discarded GOLD marker pulses once while the retained vessel shines TEAL.
scenes.narration: The salt cut keeps 90% of target activity but only 30% of total protein. Specific activity triples, from 10 to 30. Purity rose although some target was lost.

scenes.tts: Here is the guiding idea. A good step keeps a larger fraction of target activity than total protein. Specific activity rises by the ratio of those retained fractions.
scenes.visual: The two retained-fraction displays from s04 move to the middle, activity above protein. On 'guiding idea', a GOLD bracket encloses the 90% activity bar and a TEAL bracket encloses the 30% protein bar; gentle light travels along both bars. On 'larger fraction', the 90% bar stretches over the 30% bar, visibly longer. On 'ratio', the bars rotate into a fraction marked '0.90 / 0.30', then a computed arrow transforms it into '3-fold'. The smaller retained vessel stays at left with tokens circulating and occasional GREY tokens drifting toward the gate.
scenes.narration: Here is the guiding idea. A good step keeps a larger fraction of target activity than total protein. Specific activity rises by the ratio of those retained fractions.

scenes.tts: Now the late affinity step keeps about fifty-five percent of the activity it receives. It keeps only two percent of the protein. Is losing nearly half the activity a failure?
scenes.caption: Now the late affinity step keeps about 55% of the activity it receives. It keeps only 2% of the protein. Is losing nearly half the activity a failure?
scenes.visual: Transform the s05 bars into a new pair labelled 'affinity step': the GOLD activity bar drains smoothly from 100% to 55%, and the TEAL total-protein bar drains from 100% to 2%; percentage counters track every integer so the change never freezes. In the vessel, almost every GREY token streams into the RED discard tray, while just under half of the GOLD markers join them. On the question, the two bars slide apart around a large breathing question mark. A question card rises from the gate: 'Failure or best step?' (TEXT 38).
scenes.narration: Now the late affinity step keeps about 55% of the activity it receives. It keeps only 2% of the protein. Is losing nearly half the activity a failure?

scenes.visual: Deliberate thinking pause. Hold 'Failure or best step?' and the 55% versus 2% bars. Near silence. The question mark breathes from scale 1.0 to 1.06 and back; the few retained GOLD tokens orbit slowly in the small vessel, and discarded GREY tokens settle gently in the tray.

scenes.tts: No. Fifty-five percent divided by two percent is about twenty-seven. Specific activity jumps from eleven hundred to thirty thousand units per milligram. This is the best step of the whole route.
scenes.caption: No. 55% divided by 2% is about 27. Specific activity jumps from 1,100 to 30,000 units per milligram. This is the best step of the whole route.
scenes.visual: The question card flips to 'best step' in TEAL. On 'divided', the 55% GOLD bar glides above the 2% TEAL bar to form a fraction; a computed counter runs from 1 to about 27 as the GOLD bar repeatedly spans the TEAL bar. On 'jumps', the specific-activity counter rolls rapidly from '1,100' through intermediate values to '30,000 units/mg' and sends a rising TEAL beam behind the small retained vessel. The vessel still holds fewer GOLD tokens than before but almost no GREY ones; both the retained tokens and the discard tray continue subtle motion.
scenes.narration: No. 55% divided by 2% is about 27. Specific activity jumps from 1,100 to 30,000 units per milligram. This is the best step of the whole route.

scenes.tts: Two other numbers describe the trade-off. Yield is activity now divided by starting activity. Fold-purification is specific activity now divided by its starting value. One tracks quantity; the other tracks enrichment.
scenes.visual: Keep the small purified vessel at centre. On 'Yield', a GOLD ribbon unrolls leftward into a timeline from the original full vessel to the current vessel; the current and starting activity counters slide into the TEXT fraction 'activity now / activity at start', and a GOLD gauge below shrinks to show retained quantity. On 'Fold-purification', the specific-activity counter duplicates into start and current values, forming 'specific activity now / starting value'; a TEAL gauge grows upward to show enrichment. On the final sentence, the GOLD gauge rocks gently down while the TEAL gauge rises, connected by a moving double-headed trade-off arrow.
scenes.narration: Two other numbers describe the trade-off. Yield is activity now divided by starting activity. Fold-purification is specific activity now divided by its starting value. One tracks quantity; the other tracks enrichment.

scenes.tts: Across this route, activity yield falls to thirty-six percent. Yet specific activity rises three-thousandfold. Step by step, both the enrichment factors and the losses multiply.
scenes.caption: Across this route, activity yield falls to 36%. Yet specific activity rises 3,000-fold. Step by step, both the enrichment factors and the losses multiply.
scenes.visual: The timeline becomes five connected vessels labelled only 'crude', 'salt', 'ion', 'size', 'affinity' (TEXT 28+), all within the safe frame. A GOLD yield line is computed through 100%, 90%, 81%, 66%, 36% and animates from vessel to vessel as the first sentence is spoken. A TEAL fold line is computed through 1, 3, 9, 110, 3,000 on a logarithmic scale (a small TEAL label 'fold, log scale' sits at its end) and climbs above the same vessels on the second sentence; axes are absent, so a full-opacity 'computed from lesson table' label sits below. On 'multiply', the four step arrows pulse in sequence, then all pulse together while tiny token clouds circulate inside every vessel.
scenes.narration: Across this route, activity yield falls to 36%. Yet specific activity rises 3,000-fold. Step by step, both the enrichment factors and the losses multiply.

scenes.tts: The ledger judges a step; it does not choose one. Choose a property where the target differs from contaminants: solubility, charge, size, or selective binding. Then assay every fraction.
scenes.visual: Collapse the five vessels back into the carried large vessel and outlet gate. On 'does not choose', the two ledger gauges move aside and a BLUE selector wheel grows around the gate. Its four sectors appear by transforming the same gate: a salt dial labelled 'solubility', plus and minus plates labelled 'charge', two pore sizes labelled 'size', and a clasp labelled 'binding'; each label is 30+ and no molecular shapes appear. As each property is named, the wheel rotates continuously and the gate sorts a different moving subset of schematic GREY tokens away from GOLD. On 'assay every fraction', both retained and discarded streams pass under the scanning bar, lighting the activity and total-protein counters.
scenes.narration: The ledger judges a step; it does not choose one. Choose a property where the target differs from contaminants: solubility, charge, size, or selective binding. Then assay every fraction.

scenes.tts: In its simplest form, the ledger treats activity per milligram of target as constant. Inactivation can hide enrichment. Removing an inhibitor can mimic it. The text below handles these cases.
scenes.visual: Return to one vessel, one scanner and the two counters. On 'simplest form', a small chip 'assumption: target stays equally active' (TEXT 30) docks above the activity counter. On 'Inactivation', one GOLD token dims while remaining in the vessel; the activity counter falls although the gold-to-grey composition does not change. On 'Removing an inhibitor', a RED block labelled 'inhibitor' slides away from another GOLD token; that token brightens and the activity counter rises without any token leaving. On the final sentence, both cases fold into two small question-mark tabs beside the vessel while all tokens resume drifting.
scenes.narration: In its simplest form, the ledger treats activity per milligram of target as constant. Inactivation can hide enrichment. Removing an inhibitor can mimic it. The text below handles these cases.

scenes.tts: So purification is not a contest to lose nothing. Ask whether each step keeps a larger fraction of target activity than total protein. That is how selective loss creates purity.
scenes.visual: Restore the opening full vessel and repeat its separation, now without the question mark: mostly GREY tokens stream into the RED tray, a smaller fraction of GOLD activity markers leaves, and the retained vessel becomes visibly gold-rich. On 'larger fraction', the retained activity and total-protein bars reappear as 90% over 30%, with the longer GOLD bar glowing. On 'selective loss', the discard stream curls into a RED downward arrow while the specific-activity counter rises in TEAL. The remaining tokens keep circulating as the camera eases closer to the purified vessel.
scenes.narration: So purification is not a contest to lose nothing. Ask whether each step keeps a larger fraction of target activity than total protein. That is how selective loss creates purity.

scenes.visual: End card over the living purified vessel at 25% opacity; GOLD tokens continue their slow orbit. LINE (TITLE_FONT 40): 'Good steps keep a larger fraction of target activity than total protein.' Below it: biochemistrypedia.com in TEAL.
